title: How Brittle is Agent Safety? Rethinking Agent Risk under Intent Concealment and Task Complexity
reasoning: The paper introduces the OASIS benchmark, which evaluates the 'harm recognition' and safety alignment of LLM-driven agents. Because the core evaluation task involves judging the moral and ethical implications of instructions (e.g., identifying fraud, illegal knowledge acquisition, or social engineering), the work is centered on assessing the ethical boundaries and 'value alignment' of AI models.
